remarks: Attention Home Buyers, Investors & Developers! This charming 3-bedroom, 1-bath home is perfectly situated within walking distance to restaurants, grocery stores, and major highways. Town of Norwalk stated potential to put two more buildings in the back. One unit leased at $2,700/month until November, it offers immediate income for investors or flexibility for future occupancy. The true value lies in its potential - with plans (attached in disclosures) to expand the property off the back, creating additional residential space or converting to a mixed-use commercial/residential building (Do your own diligence to verify zoning and permits). Whether you're seeking cash flow, a development project, or a centrally located home, 77 Cedar Street offers unbeatable possibilities in a highly desirable location.
